hero.eyebrow: Now Hiring at Springfield Ave Dispensary
hero.title: Grow With Us
hero.lede: We’re building New Jersey’s most trusted neighborhood dispensaries — and we’re looking for great people to join the team. Competitive pay, real growth, and a crew that has your back.

roles.title: Open Roles
roles.lede: Pick the role that fits you and apply right from this page.

items.title: Budtender
items.summary: Be the face of the dispensary. Guide customers through our menu, recommend products that fit their needs, and create a welcoming, judgment-free experience.
do: Greet and educate customers on cannabis products, dosing, and effects
Process orders accurately on POS and Dutchie
Maintain a clean, organized sales floor and display cases
Verify IDs and follow all NJ-CRC compliance rules
look: Must be 21+ with a valid government-issued ID
Cannabis product knowledge (or strong desire to learn)
Excellent customer service and communication skills
Reliable transportation and weekend availability

items.title: Lead Budtender
items.summary: Set the standard on the floor. Mentor new budtenders, own product knowledge training, and help shift leads keep the customer experience tight.
do: Train and coach new budtenders on product and process
Run cash drawer reconciliation and end-of-day reports
Be the go-to expert for complex customer questions
Support the Shift Lead with floor coverage and breaks
look: 6+ months budtender experience (or equivalent retail leadership)
Deep cannabis product knowledge
Comfortable training and giving feedback to peers
Open availability including evenings and weekends

items.title: Inventory Specialist
items.summary: Own the back-of-house. Receive deliveries, audit manifests, manage expirations, and keep our Dutchie menu perfectly in sync with what is actually on the shelf.
do: Receive vendor deliveries and verify against manifests
Track expiration dates and rotate stock (FIFO)
Maintain accurate counts in Dutchie + internal inventory tools
Flag discrepancies and coordinate with management on returns
look: Prior inventory, receiving, or warehouse experience
Strong attention to detail and comfort with spreadsheets
Ability to lift up to 40 lbs
Basic familiarity with cannabis product categories is a plus

items.title: Delivery Driver
items.summary: Bring premium cannabis right to the customer’s door. Run safe, on-time deliveries throughout our service area while representing the brand with professionalism.
do: Run scheduled delivery routes in a company or personal vehicle
Verify customer ID and Dutchie Pay payment at the door
Maintain a clean driving log and follow all CRC delivery rules
Communicate ETAs and handle customer questions in transit
look: Valid NJ driver’s license with a clean driving record (3+ years)
Reliable, insured vehicle (mileage reimbursed)
Smartphone proficiency for routing and order apps
Must pass background check

items.title: Security
items.summary: Keep our team and customers safe. Monitor entry, verify IDs, and maintain a calm, welcoming presence at the front of the store.
do: Verify all customer IDs at entry (21+)
Monitor sales floor and parking lot via cameras and walkthroughs
De-escalate situations calmly and professionally
Coordinate with local law enforcement when necessary
look: NJ SORA certification preferred (or willingness to obtain)
Prior security, military, or law enforcement experience a plus
Calm under pressure with strong verbal communication
Ability to stand for long shifts

items.title: Shift Lead
items.summary: Run the floor. You’re the on-shift point person for budtenders, customer escalations, opening/closing procedures, and daily compliance.
do: Open and close the store following SOPs and compliance checklists
Coach and direct budtenders during the shift
Resolve customer escalations and process refunds/exchanges
Monitor floor coverage, break rotations, and queue times
look: 1+ year retail leadership experience (cannabis preferred)
Strong working knowledge of NJ-CRC compliance
Comfortable with POS, scheduling tools, and Dutchie back-office
Open availability including weekends and evenings

items.title: Assistant Manager
items.summary: Partner with the Store Manager on day-to-day operations, scheduling, hiring, and team performance. A direct path to Store Manager.
do: Build weekly schedules and manage time-off requests
Run interviews, onboarding, and performance check-ins
Hit daily, weekly, and monthly sales and KPI targets
Own vendor relationships and inventory planning alongside the GM
look: 2+ years retail or hospitality management experience
Cannabis industry experience strongly preferred
Strong people-leadership and conflict-resolution skills
Comfortable with reporting, P&L, and labor cost management

items.title: Store Manager
items.summary: Run the whole store. Own P&L, team development, compliance, vendor strategy, and the customer experience top to bottom.
do: Own all store-level KPIs (sales, labor, margin, compliance)
Hire, develop, and retain a high-performing team
Maintain full NJ-CRC compliance across all operations
Partner with ownership on growth, marketing, and expansion plans
look: 3+ years multi-report retail or hospitality leadership
Cannabis industry experience required
Track record of hitting financial and operational targets
Strong written and verbal communication

items.title: Marketing Coordinator
items.summary: Drive the brand forward. Own social media, in-store promotions, email campaigns, and community partnerships across both stores.
do: Plan and post content across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook
Run weekly email campaigns and product drops
Coordinate in-store events, vendor pop-ups, and community partnerships
Track campaign performance and report on what’s working
look: 1+ year hands-on marketing experience (cannabis or regulated industry a plus)
Strong copywriting and basic design skills (Canva / Figma)
Familiarity with Meta Business Suite, Mailchimp / Klaviyo
Self-starter who ships work without being micro-managed
